verdict.rationale: The RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell is positioned and documented as a professional workstation GPU for AI, data science, and 3D content creation; none of the vendor docs give gaming-specific performance claims (e.g., FPS at 4K/high refresh) and no independent game benchmarks appear anywhere in the evidence pack. Community discussion focuses on AI throughput, power draw, pricing, and manufacturing issues, not gaming performance, so there is no corroborated gaming-performance claim to credit.
